items.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Stock May Be Near Fair Value On Cash Flow
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical has had a mixed run, with the share price climbing over the past three years but giving back ground more recently. This puts the focus squarely on whether its current market value lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. Over the past three years the stock has gained 57.6%, so anyone buying or holding today is effectively betting that the company’s future cash flows can support that step up in expectations.
